answer: An admission auction makes identity slots scarce: 500 sell per epoch, each a rare marble, blocking mass fake minting. Winners lock bids as refundable bonds, returned on clean exit, slashed on fraud. Cost math: 100 fakes need 100 bids at 20 POA each, an ocean of 2,000 POA locked per epoch; one honest agent pays a single 20 POA, refundable. Honest agents accept it: rewards stay concentrated, not diluted by a rising plume of sock-puppets.
